text: Hi, welcome to the training room. Here is some important information that may be valuable.
You can buy heroes and towers on the right side of the screen. Each tower has upgrades that can be bought by left clicking on them.
Heroes will usually have an ability as well, which can be activated by right clicking them.
Heroes will also have a set amount of health. If any bloons leak without any heroes active, then you will lose.
You win by completing all of the waves in a mission. You can start the waves by pressing the spacebar. You can also send the next wave early with the spacebar.
You can also buy upgrades with the hot keys 'z', 'x', and 'c'. These correspond to the top to bottom upgrade paths.
Thanks for coming to the training room, have fun!
Rainbow Bloons contain a lot of bloons inside them.
Every 5th round will be particularly hard, with elevated bloon types, so stay alert.
A boss is spawning, use it for target practice.
When bloons reach the end of the track, they do a set amount of damage and then loop back around to the start of the track.
Mini MOABs require 50 hits to pop. Then they drop 4 rainbow bloons!

Shielded Bloons have a high density barrier that absorbs extra damage. 
Density 10: Shields absorb as much pierce as hitting 10 bloons.

Lead bloons are metallic. They resist sharp projectiles and can be damaged by explosions and other types of damage. 
Metallic: Can only be damaged by certain projectiles.
Ceramic Bloons take 10 hits to pop. Then they drop 2 rainbow bloons.

Block bloons are metallic and require 15 hits to pop. They drop 4 leads. 
Metallic: Can only be damaged by certain projectiles.
Bricks take 30 hits to pop and drop 2 ceramics.
Moabs take 200 hits to pop and drop 4 ceramics.
A huge bully is spawning.
Tattered Bloons move twice as fast. Applies to a single layer.
Deflation Bloons are an advanced form of tattered bloon. They move so fast they can't move straight through the path.
Watch out, something peculiar is sneaking through.
Peek-a-Bloons stay hidden and unpoppable while other bloons are nearby.
It's Tack the Ripper!
Zombie Bloons eventually come back to life after they have been fully popped.
Regrow Bloons regain lost layers every few seconds.
Nurse Bloons are an advanced form of regrow bloon. They constantly heal all bloons in a small area.
Frankenstein's Bloon approaches
Stuffed Bloons are an advanced form of splitter bloon. They explode into a huge number of bloons when popped.
Hot Air Bloons kidnap a random tower, stunning them until the bloon is fully popped.
The Party Tank is here!
Water Bloons shoot out water when popped that push projectiles away.
On the horizon... It's MOAB-y Dick!
Bee Bloons buzz around instead of moving directly on the track.
Bloom Bloons create beautiful flower arrangements when popped.
Camo Bloons sneak by and are not targetable while other bloons are in range.
You have alerted the Beekeeper.
Rune Bloons are protected by a magic shield with 10 density.
Tower Bloons take 150 hits to pop, and drop 2 bricks.
HTAs take 60 hits to pop, and have 10 density.
The wizard of this tower is heading out.
It's time to play chess bloons advanced.
Bloons on the chess board can only be damaged by towers placed on the chess board.
However you must be careful, as towers on the chess board can be captured and stunned by chess bloons.
Additionally if a chess board bloon reaches the bottom of the board, it will begin to travel in the normal path.
Rubber Block Bloons redirect projectiles that hit them.
Tire Bloons accelerate rapidly. When hit their speed is dropped. They also redirect projectiles that hit them.
Cactus Bloons rapidly shoot needles when popped, that damage bloons or stun towers.
The catapult launches ceramic bloons forward along the track. Drops 4 tires when popped.
The rocket moab moves insanely fast. It drops speed after traversing 50% of the path. When popped it drops 4 tattered ceramics.
Woah! It's a Monster Truck!
Static Bloons are shielded, and shoot electricity which stun nearby towers.
Barrier Bloons apply shields to all nearby bloons.
Uh oh someone called the police.
The Skyscraper takes 250 hits to pop, and is metallic. When popped it drops 4 Iron Blocks.
Traffic Laws must now be obeyed!
The stock prices of towers are about to be manipulated.
Funds are about to be embezzled, and new bloon real estate is about to be purchased.
Each Lawyer Bloon upholds a separate law. The bloon must be popped in order to end the law.
The judge, the jury, and the executioner...
If the scales of justice tip too far in one direction, you will be found guilty and punished accordingly!
Being back here instills Jim with a deep melancholy...
